data.one_liner: WYSIWYG HTML text editor for Flutter based on the Summernote JavaScript wrapper.
data.what_it_does: Provides a text editor widget for Android and iOS that allows users to write and edit HTML content visually using a WebView wrapper around Summernote. Includes customizable toolbars, hints, and helper options for attachments and text manipulation.
use_when: You need a WYSIWYG HTML text editor inside a mobile or desktop Flutter app.
You want to use Summernote-based editing features with custom toolbars.
avoid_when: You need native interactive text selection within the TextField.
You require complex direct media embedding via the editor toolbar (attachments use a separate picker).
strengths: Easy to setup with customizable toolbars and popovers.
Provides helper options for showing or hiding attachments and bottom toolbars.
weaknesses: Depends on webview_flutter and cannot add images or videos directly using the editor toolbar.
Does not support enableinteractiveSelection from standard TextFields.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding iOS permissions for camera, microphone, and photo library, plus setting io.flutter.embedded_views_preview and NSAppTransportSecurity keys in Info.plist.
